description: Passes stereo audio through while adding the plugin's meta features to Rack: the click of a cable being plugged in or pulled out, and a brief mute when a patch is opened

inputs.text: The left audio to pass through
The right audio to pass through; with no cable it takes the left input

outputs.text: The left audio with the cable sounds mixed into it
The right audio with the cable sounds mixed into it

notes: the module has no controls on its panel at all; everything it does is set from the right-click menu or from the plugin's settings
patch the signal that would have gone to an audio output module through this one, then take its outputs to that audio module; the cable sounds are mixed in on the way
the cable glow and cable light options, and the sounds themselves, are in the plugin settings submenu rather than on this module's own menu
both jacks are monophonic, whatever is patched in
menu: Pre-muter settings — a slider setting how long the audio is held silent after a patch is opened
